prompts.prompt: Create NEW MONDBRUCH / MOONFALL COAST final-region battle arena for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached panorama is ONLY style, front battle camera perspective and framing reference. Match polished painterly semi-realistic game art, very wide 2.46:1, 1967x800. Epic endgame setting: a devastated coastal impact crater at night where a gigantic fragment of the MOON has crashed into the far ocean. Enormous pale cratered lunar sphere split into several separated curved slabs looms across the upper background, suspended boulders and broken orbital arcs defying gravity around it. Deep indigo starry sky and thin silver clouds, cold silver-blue moonlight reflecting over a distant dark sea. Jagged moonstone impact ridges frame both sides, a few hovering rocks near outer cliffs. Composition ESSENTIAL: lower 55 percent is a broad EMPTY FLAT continuous gray impact-rock clearing for three massive enemies, foreground starts at bottom edge, coast and sea beyond horizon near 45 percent height. No giant central pit, no obstacles or floating rocks blocking combat ground. Detailed lunar fragments at foreground corners, sparse thin silver-blue cracks along EDGES only. Sense of huge cosmic power and melancholy beauty, restrained luminous accents, readable dark mid-gray floor. No trees, lava, buildings, characters, monsters, text, UI or borders. Fill entire panorama.

Create NEW MONDGEFALLENER / MOONFALLEN, an immensely powerful celestial colossus for the FINAL region of dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached creature is ONLY quality/rendering and front-camera reference, NOT design. New creature: massive broad-shouldered ancient moonstone TITAN, body formed of cracked IVORY/PEARL-GRAY cratered lunar plates surrounding a pitch-black star-speckled void. EXACTLY FOUR ARMS: two enormous outer arms with heavy segmented forearms and broad FIVE-fingered stone hands held low/outward; two smaller inner arms emerging below chest with open palms half raised. TWO short heavy stone legs hovering slightly, blunt segmented feet, no wings. Small impassive angular face mask with TWO narrow white-blue eyes, no mouth or teeth. At chest center a black spherical ECLIPSE CORE edged with thin bright silver-blue light. A broken CRESCENT CROWN of THREE large floating curved moonstone slabs arcs behind/above head, integrated into sprite with CLEAR transparent gaps between slabs, NOT a glowing background. Some limb plates hover a short distance apart at joints, held by thin silver-blue energy seams; no disconnected random rubble. Ceremonial, ancient, terrifying majesty, no clothes or weapon, not a snarling animal. IDLE pose facing viewer squarely, imposing symmetry, slight levitation, huge silhouette, full body. Detailed polished semi-realistic RPG rendering, pitted stone texture and exquisite material highlights matching reference quality. Square 1254x1254, ENTIRE titan and crescent crown inside x7%-93%, crown near y6%, feet near y88%, clear empty space below. No floor, cast shadow plane, starfield outside body, background, halo glow, smoke, text or UI. Genuine transparent alpha.
